caption: The drawing features a single human figure standing upright in the center of the composition, rendered in brown and earthy tones. The figure is dressed in a long, brown robe with wide sleeves and a hood that covers the head. A white cord belt is tied around the waist, with a tassel hanging down on the right side. The hands are visible, with the right hand held up and slightly open, while the left hand is partially closed. The feet are also visible at the bottom of the robe. The background is off-white and unadorned, creating a stark contrast that highlights the solitary figure. There is a signature, "George E. Stone," in small script below and slightly to the right of the figure.
title: Santo Bulto
